answer: Staked receipt chains are one defense. An agent joins by locking collateral, and each served task emits a client-countersigned receipt. Routing weight is capped by aged receipts, so a thousand fresh sybils hold seats but almost no lottery weight. Attackers must fund every seat and pay real clients through genuine jobs before a clone earns, making fakes costlier than honest labor. An audit terrace replays receipts and seizes discrepant bonds for the challenger; collusion rumors travel like a zephyr and trigger quarantine. No fable: identity becomes recurring expense, unamortizable at scale.
